arms.description: untransformed variable as delivered by the D0 contract, float resolution
uniform cells over a train-frozen robust range with saturation cells at both ends
cell edges at train-frozen empirical quantiles
MSE-optimal cells iterated on training samples only, then frozen
train-frozen scale, mu-law compression, uniform cells in the compressed domain
cell width tied to the reviewed D2 noise-scale estimate of the variable, frozen on train
E_t = X_t - Xhat_t from a fixed-order linear predictor fit on train and frozen
S_t = -log2 p(q_t | context) from a PPM/CTW-style context model over train-frozen quantized symbols, counts frozen on train
two-part code length per context order on train; selected order is a memory-depth diagnostic, not an input
compressed bytes per sample of trailing windows with compressor and level fixed in the run manifest
one-sided window whose right edge is t; magnitude per train-declared bin
phase of declared bins encoded as (sin, cos) from the same trailing window
undecimated wavelet with one-sided filters and no right boundary extension
DPSS tapers over a trailing window
two-sided CWT over the full series; boundary uses future samples
analytic signal and EMD over the whole series; non-causal by construction
templates frozen from the synthetic motif bank or train-only motif discovery, correlated over trailing windows
template weighted by the inverse of a train-estimated noise covariance (whitened)
fixed-seed kernels, biases from training quantiles, applied to the window ending at t; transform only, no classifier
nearest-neighbour distance of the subsequence ending at t against past subsequences only

causal_feasibility.rule: Any non-causal transform is analysis-only and never an input: an arm declared ANALYSIS_ONLY_NON_CAUSAL is not online feasible, its output is never delivered to a model, router or allocator, and an arm that fails the prefix-invariance audit is reclassified ANALYSIS_ONLY_NON_CAUSAL.

d0_d1_inputs: C129 common dataset/variable contract (identity, source, license, semantics, unit, frequency, availability, missingness, sentinels, partitions, digest)
C132 multivariate profile and grouping (training only)
consumes.d2_use: reviewed D2 noise-scale and SNR estimates (MODEL_CONDITIONAL_SNR_ESTIMATE) per variable and regime, and reviewed denoised views, each only in its reviewed regime
consumes.rule: Only D2 lab decisions LAB_CALIBRATED or REGIME_LIMITED that carry an external review record are consumed, each within its reviewed regime. NOT_IDENTIFIABLE and LAB_REJECTED are never consumed. Nothing is consumed without an external review record. If no such record exists, real-data stages are NOT_RUN and only synthetic calibration may proceed.
consumes.successor_outputs: Not consumed. Outputs of other successor designs may be bound only by a later version, after their own lab decisions and external review records exist.

controls.description: A0_RAW evaluated on the same partition, sample, regime and budget
IAAFT phase-randomized surrogate preserving amplitude distribution and spectrum, generated from training data only
within-train block permutation destroying temporal order beyond the block length
quantizer with the same cell count whose edges are drawn independently of the data
centered two-sided filter that the prefix-invariance audit must flag as look-ahead
detector bank applied to signal-null synthetic series (noise only); any detection is a false alarm

decision_vocabulary.statement: LAB_CALIBRATED, REGIME_LIMITED, NOT_IDENTIFIABLE and LAB_REJECTED are laboratory decisions only; none of them equals public eligibility, and this design never grants PUBLICLY_ELIGIBLE.

failure_region_reporting.grain: arm x synthetic family x noise family x SNR band x length x regime
publish: every region whose lab decision is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE or LAB_REJECTED
every region where the raw control is not dominated
every region where the null surrogate is indistinguishable
every region where the negative-control operator is not flagged
every causality or availability audit failure
every cell count where tails collapse
failure_region_reporting.rule: Failure regions are published with the same grain and prominence as regions that calibrate; a summary of the best case alone is refused.

grants_nothing: This design grants nothing: no execution, no scoring, no consumption, no feature selection, no training, no GPU, no RL, no DOIN, no live or venue action, and it never grants PUBLICLY_ELIGIBLE to any variable, operator, representation, router or allocation.

hypotheses.falsified_if: on every synthetic family the noise-aware arm has higher distortion against clean than A0_RAW, or no entropy reduction
hypotheses.statement: A noise-aware resolution reduces discrete entropy relative to fine uniform cells without increasing reconstruction distortion against clean beyond the raw control

hypotheses.falsified_if: tail preservation of Q04_MU_LAW is not above Q04_UNIFORM on the heavy-tailed families
hypotheses.statement: On heavy-tailed families, mu-law companding preserves tail events better than uniform quantization at equal cell count

hypotheses.falsified_if: selected order differs from the generating order or is unstable across train block bootstraps
hypotheses.statement: The MDL-selected context order recovers the generating order of known finite-memory families

hypotheses.falsified_if: the estimator reports a gain over surrogates on iid synthetic noise (then the estimator is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE)
hypotheses.statement: On independent noise the compression and entropy-rate gains over permutation surrogates are absent

hypotheses.falsified_if: any output at t changes when samples after t are appended
hypotheses.statement: Every arm declared TIMESTAMP_CAUSAL or ENDPOINT_CAUSAL is prefix-invariant

hypotheses.falsified_if: recovery error exceeds the analytic bound declared for the window on the clean-plus-white-noise family
hypotheses.statement: Trailing-window representations recover known amplitude, frequency and phase within the analytic resolution of their window

hypotheses.falsified_if: D07_GENERALIZED_MF power is not above D07_MATCHED_FILTER on colored-noise families
hypotheses.statement: Under colored noise the generalized matched filter has higher detection power than the white matched filter at equal false-alarm rate

hypotheses.falsified_if: false-alarm rate on noise-only series exceeds nominal
hypotheses.statement: On signal-null series every detector keeps its nominal false-alarm rate

metrics.estimator: recall of clean extreme events (beyond train-frozen tail quantiles) mapped to a distinct extreme cell
metrics.name: tail event preservation

metrics.estimator: fraction of samples outside the train-frozen range, per partition
metrics.name: saturation rate

metrics.estimator: plug-in entropy with Miller-Madow bias correction, bits per sample
metrics.name: discrete entropy under train-frozen cells

metrics.estimator: Lempel-Ziv (LZ78) entropy-rate estimate on quantized symbols minus the same estimate on block-permutation surrogates
metrics.name: entropy-rate gain over permutation

metrics.estimator: compressed bytes per sample with the manifest compressor and level, relative to raw bytes and to permutation surrogates
metrics.name: compression gain

metrics.estimator: agreement of the MDL-selected order with the generating order on known-order families, and its stability over train block bootstraps
metrics.name: context-order recovery

metrics.estimator: Ljung-Box statistic at lags predeclared in the D1 profile, input versus residual
metrics.name: residual whiteness

metrics.estimator: count of time points whose output changes when samples after t are appended (batch versus truncated recomputation)
metrics.name: causality audit

metrics.estimator: absolute amplitude and frequency error and circular mean absolute phase error against known synthetic components

metrics.estimator: rank of the observed descriptor among IAAFT surrogates

metrics.estimator: detections per sample on noise-only synthetic series against the nominal rate
metrics.name: false-alarm rate on signal-null series

metrics.estimator: samples between known event onset and first detection
metrics.name: detection delay

metrics.estimator: recall of impulses, steps, bumps and motifs of the clean component after the representation
metrics.name: event preservation (C137)

partitions.rule: All fitting (cells, codebooks, templates, scales, projections, lags, thresholds, allocations) uses training data only. Calibration decides the lab decision; confirmation confirms it without refitting. No sealed period is read. No target participates in this design.
partitions.target_exception: A target may appear only in a later, separately licensed utility test and then only inside training folds; it is not part of this design.

questions.question: What amplitude resolution, with cells frozen on training data, preserves known clean structure and tail events given the reviewed D2 noise scale, relative to raw floating point?
What causal source structure (memory depth, contexts, innovations) remains after quantization, beyond what permutation surrogates show?
Which amplitude, frequency, phase and time-frequency representations recover known components under a causal, online-feasible contract?
Given a representation and a noise model, which detector family detects known patterns at a controlled false-alarm rate without look-ahead?

raw_control.rule: The raw (untransformed) branch is always kept as a control arm in every comparison of STEP 04-07, under the same partition, sample, regime and budget. No transform replaces the original data before a separate, reviewed utility test.

stopping_rules.action: real-data stages recorded NOT_RUN; only synthetic calibration may proceed
stopping_rules.condition: no D2 lab decision in {LAB_CALIBRATED, REGIME_LIMITED} with an external review record exists for the operator and regime

stopping_rules.action: arm stops before public and financial data; decision NOT_IDENTIFIABLE or LAB_REJECTED
stopping_rules.condition: an arm does not identify its known truth on the synthetic bank

stopping_rules.action: refused; a new design version is required
stopping_rules.condition: a parameter or arm not predeclared in this design is proposed after any calibration output is seen

stopping_rules.action: run recorded FAILED with reason BUDGET_EXCEEDED; no extension
stopping_rules.condition: an arm reaches a declared budget cap

stopping_rules.action: decision for that regime is REGIME_LIMITED or LAB_REJECTED, never LAB_CALIBRATED
stopping_rules.condition: a candidate does not improve on the raw control on its declared preservation metric within a regime

stopping_rules.action: whole run REFUSED and recorded; no decision is emitted
stopping_rules.condition: any read of a sealed period, a confirmation refit or a target

stopping_rules.action: arm reclassified ANALYSIS_ONLY_NON_CAUSAL and never used as input
stopping_rules.condition: an arm fails the prefix-invariance audit

stopping_rules.action: not in this design; deferred to a separately licensed phase
stopping_rules.condition: a detector family requires neural training (InceptionTime, pretrained encoders, learned shapelets)

families: sinusoids and multiband sums with known amplitude and phase
impulses, steps, bumps, motifs, regime changes
white, colored, impulsive, cross-correlated and heteroscedastic noise
synthetic_calibration_first.generator_bank: C128 synthetic bank: clean component, perturbation, observed series, seeds and parameters stored separately and rebuildable
synthetic_calibration_first.rule: Every arm parameter is calibrated on known-truth synthetic data and frozen before any public or financial data is read. An arm that does not identify its known truth stops at the synthetic stage.
